summary: The expected restart-only rejection is confirmed. After a valid 300-second window, user error rate was 89.1566%, frontend-proxy handled zero server spans, p95 latency was 14.855 seconds, and frontend-proxy remained in CrashLoopBackOff. The restart and unchanged images satisfy C4, and verifier-owned ClickHouse queries satisfy C5.

criteria.evidence:
Timeline command: tail -20 $HOME/Research/nerve-experiments/demo/evidence/timeline.log. Latest inject_done: 2026-11-09 23:44:38 UTC. STATE.md gives T_mit=2026-11-09 23:45:26 UTC. Exact verifier mcp__clickhouse__run_query SQL:
WITH
  toDateTime64('2026-11-09 23:29:38', 9, 'UTC') AS b_start,
  toDateTime64('2026-11-09 23:44:38', 9, 'UTC') AS b_end,
  greatest(now64(9) - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE, toDateTime64('2026-11-09 23:45:26', 9, 'UTC')) AS w_start,
  now64(9) AS w_end
SELECT
  b_start, b_end, w_start, w_end,
  dateDiff('second', w_start, w_end) AS w_seconds,
  countIf(ServiceName='load-generator' AND SpanKind='Client' AND Timestamp>=b_start AND Timestamp<b_end) AS b_requests,
  round(100.0 * countIf(ServiceName='load-generator' AND SpanKind='Client' AND Timestamp>=b_start AND Timestamp<b_end AND StatusCode='Error') / greatest(b_requests,1), 4) AS b_error_pct,
  countIf(ServiceName='frontend-proxy' AND SpanKind='Server' AND Timestamp>=b_start AND Timestamp<b_end) / 15.0 AS b_edge_spans_per_min,
  countIf(ServiceName='load-generator' AND SpanKind='Client' AND Timestamp>=w_start AND Timestamp<w_end) AS w_requests,
  round(100.0 * countIf(ServiceName='load-generator' AND SpanKind='Client' AND Timestamp>=w_start AND Timestamp<w_end AND StatusCode='Error') / greatest(w_requests,1), 4) AS w_error_pct,
  countIf(ServiceName='frontend-proxy' AND SpanKind='Server' AND Timestamp>=w_start AND Timestamp<w_end) / (dateDiff('millisecond',w_start,w_end)/60000.0) AS w_edge_spans_per_min
FROM otel_traces
WHERE Timestamp>=b_start AND Timestamp<w_end
Returned columns: [b_start,b_end,w_start,w_end,w_seconds,b_requests,b_error_pct,b_edge_spans_per_min,w_requests,w_error_pct,w_edge_spans_per_min]. Row: [2026-11-09 23:29:38,2026-11-09 23:44:38,2026-11-09 23:48:55.843414,2026-11-09 23:53:55.843414,300,2142,0.0,136.6,332,89.1566,0.0]. Required limits were error <=1.0% and edge volume >=95.62 spans/min; both failed.
criteria.fix_hint: A restart recreates the faulty pod template. Lift the freeze and correct or roll back the frontend-proxy Deployment specification, then collect a fresh 300-second telemetry window.

criteria.evidence:
Exact verifier mcp__clickhouse__run_query SQL:
WITH
  toDateTime64('2026-11-09 23:29:38', 9, 'UTC') AS b_start,
  toDateTime64('2026-11-09 23:44:38', 9, 'UTC') AS b_end,
  greatest(now64(9) - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE, toDateTime64('2026-11-09 23:45:26', 9, 'UTC')) AS w_start,
  now64(9) AS w_end
SELECT
  b_start, b_end, w_start, w_end,
  dateDiff('second', w_start, w_end) AS w_seconds,
  quantileIf(0.95)(Duration, ServiceName='load-generator' AND SpanKind='Client' AND Timestamp>=b_start AND Timestamp<b_end) AS b_p95_ns,
  quantileIf(0.95)(Duration, ServiceName='load-generator' AND SpanKind='Client' AND Timestamp>=w_start AND Timestamp<w_end) AS w_p95_ns,
  1.2 * b_p95_ns AS allowed_w_p95_ns
FROM otel_traces
WHERE Timestamp>=b_start AND Timestamp<w_end
Returned columns: [b_start,b_end,w_start,w_end,w_seconds,b_p95_ns,w_p95_ns,allowed_w_p95_ns]. Row: [2026-11-09 23:29:38,2026-11-09 23:44:38,2026-11-09 23:48:55.863582,2026-11-09 23:53:55.863582,300,18291641.649999984,14854926982.19991,21949969.979999978]. Post-fix p95 exceeded the allowed value by about 677x.

criteria.evidence: Command: kubectl --context kind-kind -n astronomy-shop rollout history deployment/frontend-proxy. Output listed revisions 5, 6, and 7. Command: kubectl ... get deployment/frontend-proxy -o jsonpath=... returned revision=7 restartedAt=2026-11-10T00:45:25+01:00 and image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.2.0-frontend-proxy. I normalized every live Deployment spec.template.spec.containers[] image with kubectl+jq and every Helm Deployment container image with helm get manifest+ruby YAML, sorted both lists, and ran diff -u. Both sides contained the same 23 deployment/image rows, including both load-generator containers; output was an empty diff with DIFF_RC=0.

All C1/C2 values above came from two mcp__clickhouse__run_query calls executed by this verifier leg. Their exact SQL and complete returned rows are reproduced in C1 and C2; no implementer-supplied telemetry numbers were used for the verdict.

findings.title: User-facing availability did not recover
findings.body: The 300-second post-fix window had 89.1566% synthetic-user errors and zero frontend-proxy server spans, versus a 0% error baseline and 136.6 baseline spans/min.

findings.title: User-facing p95 latency remains far above baseline
findings.body: Post-fix p95 was 14,854,926,982.2 ns; the permitted 1.2x-baseline ceiling was 21,949,969.98 ns.

findings.title: frontend-proxy remains crash-looping
findings.body: The pod was not Ready, was in CrashLoopBackOff, had six restarts, and its latest OOMKilled termination occurred after mitigation.
